source_prompt: Ultra-detailed surreal pharmaceutical research laboratory at twilight, wide cinematic 16:9 composition. Center: a translucent teal glass molecular model of a double-helix drug scaffold floating above a brushed-steel bench, with glowing cyan bond lines and amber atom nodes. Left: a wall-sized holographic dashboard titled "EvidenceGrade AI" in bold white sans-serif, showing a 5-tier grade ladder (A emerald, B teal, C gold, D orange, F crimson) and a line chart labeled "Citation Confidence 2019-2026". Right: a large arched window revealing a rainy neo-Tokyo street with neon kanji signs reflecting on wet asphalt, a red umbrella leaning against the window sill, and a black cat silhouette on the ledge. Foreground: an open leather notebook with handwritten notes "CYP3A4 interaction risk" and a fountain pen, next to a white ceramic coffee cup with a teal lid and a cracked porcelain saucer. Ceiling: brass articulated lamps casting warm pools of light; one lamp has a green glass shade. Background shelves: amber glass reagent bottles labeled Aspirin, Warfarin, Ibuprofen in clean black type, a vintage brass microscope, and a small potted monstera plant with one yellow leaf. Atmosphere: volumetric god-rays through rain-streaked glass, subtle film grain, high dynamic range, teal-and-amber complementary color grade, no logos of real companies, no watermarks, photorealistic mixed with holographic UI.

results.reconstructed_prompt: Cinematic 3D render, realistic studio/lab interior at night, teal-and-orange color grade, soft volumetric lighting, high detail, octane render style. Wide perspective view of a sleek metal desk in the foreground. On the left, a large floating translucent holographic display panel with a glowing cyan border; bold white sans-serif title "EvidenceGrade AI" at top; left column header "5-tier grade" above five stacked horizontal grade bars each with a white letter — green bar "A", teal bar "B", gold bar "C", orange bar "D", red-pink bar "F"; right column a line chart titled "Citation Confidence 2019-2026" with y-axis ticks 0–60 and x-axis label "Citation Confidence 2019-2026", a glowing cyan line trending upward. Center of the frame, hovering above the desk, a glowing 3D ball-and-stick molecular structure made of translucent teal spheres and rods with a few gold/amber spheres. Background wall with white shelves holding rows of brown glass apothecary bottles with white labels reading "Aspirin", "Warfarin", "Ibuprofen", plus binders; a brass microscope on the counter left; a potted green monstera plant on the counter right. Ceiling with articulated brass pendant lamps, one with a green glass shade, others warm-white glowing. Right side a tall arched window with rain streaks on the glass looking out onto a wet neon-lit city street at night with vertical pink, red and cyan neon signs bearing Chinese characters; on the windowsill a black cat silhouette and a leaning red umbrella. Foreground desk: an open spiral notebook on a brown leather folder with handwritten text "CYP3A4 interaction risk" and faint scribbles, a gold-and-black pen resting on the page; to the right a white ceramic coffee cup with a teal lid on a cracked white saucer. Moody, atmospheric, neon glow, shallow depth of field, photorealistic materials.
